articles.title: Sony’s flagship ANC headphones now support low-latency Bluetooth with a free update.
articles.description:
A new firmware update for the Sony WH-1000XM6 and 1000X The Collexion headphones is now available through the Sony Sound Connect mobile app. In addition to performance improvements the update adds support for the low-latency Bluetooth Gaming Audio Profile, but keep in mind the device you’re pairing with needs to support GMAP, too.
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/05/257746_Sony_WH-1000XM6_AKrales_0231.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]
